title_zh: 确认孩子的足球年龄组与首次训练

scenario.goal_zh: 核实年龄要求并了解初次训练安排

context_zh: 家长为九岁的孩子咨询社区球队，并确认第一次到场时可以向谁求助。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: My son is nine. Is he old enough for this group?

sentences.speaker: Coach Rivera
sentences.text: Yes. This session is for children aged eight to ten.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: He has not played on a team before. Can someone assist him at the start?

sentences.speaker: Coach Rivera
sentences.text: Of course. I will show him where to put his bag and introduce him to a partner.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: When should we arrive for his first session?

sentences.speaker: Coach Rivera
sentences.text: Saturday at nine forty-five. Training starts at ten, but that gives us time to meet.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: We will be here at nine forty-five. I will ask for you at the entrance.

sentences.speaker: Coach Rivera
sentences.text: Please do. Bring trainers and a water bottle, and we will provide the ball.
